links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of chatbot and ACP patient education answers by topic
links.effect: Readability varied by topic: prosthodontist topic had lowest Reading Ease and highest grade level; brushing and flossing had highest Reading Ease and lowest grade level (p < 0.001).
links.quote: The cumulative scores of the prosthodontist topic had the lowest Flesch Reading Ease Scale score, while brushing and flossing topics displayed the highest score (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates readability and accuracy of several LLMs (ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini) compared to professional guidelines for prosthodontic patient education questions without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
